meta.label: Patch 26.22
meta.caveat: PBE content can change before release.
notes: Live is now patch 26.21, so this page lists only what's new in 26.22.
Update 2026-10-26 (patch 26.22): Armored Impact, BEES!!! and Take'em Down Down Down are changed.
Update 2026-10-23 (patch 26.22): 9 augments leave the pool, and Varus gets stronger.
Update 2026-10-21: Lee Sin's Mayhem W shield now grows with rank.
Ability values are listed for ranks 1-5 (basic abilities) or 1-3 (ultimates).

fame.summary: The Worlds band unlocks with this patch. Earn Fame to reach it.

superstarRank.summary: Fame also raises your Superstar Rank (10 milestones on its own track) and unlocks bands plus Audition Missions, which must be completed within a single game.

added.name: RISE
added.description: Pick an ability: if it kills an enemy champion, you can recast it up to 2 more times. Each recast deals 25% more damage than the last.

added.name: One Hit Wonder
added.description: Pick an ability: it deals more damage for each point of Ability Haste you have, but Ability Haste no longer lowers its cooldown.

changes.stat: Missing Health damage at max stacks

championOverrides.note: Mayhem only. Regular games are unchanged.

headliners.summary: New on the test server. Each Mayhem match has one Headliner that adds game-wide bonuses.

list.name: Superfans
list.effect: Everyone's level cap rises to 21 and everyone gains extra XP. Reaching level 21 gives an extra augment.

championChanges.summary: Base-game champion changes on the test server. They also apply in Mayhem.

changes: Base AD 54 → 52, Attack Speed per level 2.5% → 2.75%
Passive bonus bolt damage at level 1: 8 → 4
Q reworked: first hit 60 + 25% AP, then 5/10/15/20/25 + 8% AP per extra bolt (was 60/85/110/135/160 + 55% AP, then 5/7/9/11/13 + 5% AP per bolt)
W reworked: shield 80/110/140/170/200 + 70% AP → 50/80/110/140/170 + 50% AP for 2s, with 10–30% Move Speed and damage to nearby enemies; it no longer reflects projectiles
Passive Attack Speed after a minion kill 11% → 14%, after a champion kill 33% → 42%

itemChanges.summary: Changes to items in the Mayhem shop. Runes are unchanged.

modeChanges: Minion XP shared by 5 nearby allies drops from 24% to 20% each (regular ARAM too).
